      • invokeSelectionBar

        public static SelectionBarInvoker.SelectionExpression invokeSelectionBar(int dbNo,
                                                                         String criteria)
        Opens the object selection UI dialog and builds the selection expression from G|selkrit and G|selrohlref. If the dialog has been closed without any choice this method returns null.
        Parameters:
        dbNo - The database number.
        criteria - The initial criteria.
        Returns:
        The selection expression or null.
